discovery: Development of controlled/living radical polymerization (atom transfer radical polymerization and related methods) for precise synthesis of functional polymers
rationale: Recent prizes have gone to biochemistry/computation (2024) and materials/framework chemistry (2025). Polymer synthesis is a long-overdue core-chemistry field that has gone unrecognized since 2005 (metathesis). Matyjaszewski and Sawamoto independently discovered metal-catalyzed living radical polymerization (ATRP) in 1995. The method is among the most cited in chemistry and is used throughout industry, and both have repeatedly been named in Clarivate and Wolf Prize shortlists.
